disposalRegression.failure: Cylinder display epoch is not prepared.
disposalRegression.cause: The host disposes a retired session before React unmount. A queued old Canvas frame could read its disposed cache.
disposalRegression.fix: Read-only session closed state stops retired frames. The source-revision guard is unchanged.
disposalRegression.finalCoverage: All three detail/signed-zero tests now capture and assert no page errors; final 12 cases also cover all tools/rims, legacy Save/Open, unavailable-WebGL Canvas fallback and five replacement/reopen loops under CPU throttling.

contracts.coordinates: Concentric/coaxial closed cylinders; common centered parent XYZ. Accepted kernels retain z in [0,L] and translate by -L/2 only in parent adapter.
contracts.orientation: Inner U reflection gives inward physical normals and right-handed side/cap tangents; fold transport conjugated. Exact integer-column ownership reflection, odd/even periodic counts and shared rim keys.
contracts.authority: Two independent accepted cylindrical terrain banks initially zero, own radius/length/IDs. Existing brush, path, worker, sparse history and cache machinery retained.
contracts.heightPolicy: Generic optional initial height and synchronous captured host policies applied to direct writes and the entire existing atomic prepared-patch validation before any write. Existing history applies patch before moving its cursor.
contracts.dimensions: Each radius/length 1..1e9 m; each length/radius .1..20; nested radii/lengths; radial/end thickness >= max(.001 m, corresponding outer dimension *1e-9).
contracts.heights: Minimum -min(radialT,endT)/4; inside max min(Rin/2,Lin/4); outside max min(Rout,Lout); reject rather than clamp.
contracts.legacy: Existing cylinders remain -100 m and v4. Revision-zero display reads actual uniform initial height. No other saved-format or database-version change.

qualifications: This checkpoint is numerical infrastructure only; no selectable hollow-cylinder editor, cavity view, parent Save/Open or new cylinder holes/networks/links is claimed.

The initial numerical gesture test chose an exact footprint-boundary radius and the accepted kernel refused a Float64 precision-floor ambiguity. Ordinary supported radius 397.3 m is tested; distance/falloff safeguards were not weakened.
Browser tests use desktop and Pixel 7 emulation, genuine WebGL2 or forced Canvas fallback, and browser CPU throttling. This is not physical-device or owner/Ember acceptance.

A diagnostic run wrote two historical evidence paths. Both were restored exactly from the unchanged Git checkpoint and verified by SHA256. New diagnostic copies are separate in .local/hollow-cylinder-disposal-before. Final legacy tests ran from an isolated working directory.
Open ends are not represented by hidden caps or equal capped-cylinder lengths. Their topology/global metric still needs the authorized separate assessment.
No website, shared database, Docker or Production changes.
